Package aor.proj3t.service.impl

Class UserServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.service.impl.BaseService
aor.proj3t.service.impl.UserServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserService
@ApplicationScoped public class UserServiceImpl extends BaseService implements UserService
Implementation of the UserService interface. This comprehensive service handles all user-related operations including registration, authentication, profile management, role assignment, and user data retrieval with filtering and pagination.

Key functionalities include:

  • User registration with email confirmation
  • User profile management and updates
  • Password management and reset functionality
  • Manager assignment and role management
  • User search and filtering capabilities
  • Profile picture upload and management
  • User statistics and reporting

This service integrates with multiple external services including email utilities, file storage, JWT token management, and password hashing utilities.

      public void registerUser(LoginDTO loginDTO, String ipAddress)
      Initiates the user registration process by creating a pending registration. Sends a confirmation email with a token for account activation.

      Implementation note: Creates a pending registration with expiration token and sends confirmation email asynchronously.

    • uploadProfilePicture

      public Boolean uploadProfilePicture(Long requesterId, Long userId, FileUploadDTO fileUploadDTO)
      Uploads and sets a new profile picture for a user. This method handles file validation, storage, and updates the user's photograph field. Users can upload their own profile pictures, and admins can upload for any user.
      Specified by:
      uploadProfilePicture in interface UserService
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the upload request
      userId - the ID of the user whose profile picture is being updated
      fileUploadDTO - the file upload data containing the image information
      Returns:
      true if the upload was successful, false otherwise
      Throws:
      NotFoundException - if either the requester or target user doesn't exist
      ForbiddenException - if the requester lacks permission to upload for the target user
